lines.text: The LORD tells Moses and Aaron to count the Kohathite men from thirty to fifty years old.
After Aaron and his sons cover the holy objects, the Kohathites carry them but must not touch them.
Eleazar son of Aaron oversees the oil, the incense, the grain offering, and the anointing oil, plus the entire tabernacle.
The Gershonites carry the curtains of the tabernacle and courtyard, under the direction of Phinehas son of Aaron.
The Merarites carry the frames and posts of the tabernacle, and each item is assigned to them by lot.
